Issues - Michael Baumgartner Skip to Main Issues Abortion I support each state’s right to determine its own abortion laws, in accordance with the U.S. Constitution. Agriculture I am a strong advocate for the farmers and ranchers of Eastern Washington. I believe in protecting our agricultural supply chain and boosting market access while supporting timber communities and improving forest health. Education I support local control of education and empowering parents to have choice and options in their children’s schools. Energy Read relevant news, information and initiatives regarding Energy. Government Spending I support policies to reduce inflation and curb reckless government spending, which I believe is driving up prices and increasing the national debt. Heathcare I support a healthcare system that is patient-centered, affordable, and transparent. Every American deserves the freedom to make informed choices that are the best for them and their families and not be forced to follow bureaucratic directives. Immigration I strongly support securing our border and enforcing existing immigration laws to prevent drugs and unvetted migrants from entering the country illegally. Military I will work to support and advocate for upgrades to Fairchild Air Force Base, ensuring it remains a key part of our national defense network and local community. National Security I support a strong and smart American foreign policy, ensuring that the Chinese Communist Government does not buy strategic US assets like water rights, energy infrastructure, or farmland near military bases. Second Amendment I support policies that guarantee Americans their 2nd Amendment rights. The 2nd Amendment must be protected, not only for personal freedom and hunting but also as a safeguard against government tyranny. Social Security/Medicare Senior citizens should receive every penny of the Social Security and Medicare benefits that they have been promised. Veterans I will work tirelessly to ensure the VA focuses on health care rather than bureaucracy, holding it accountable and improving services for veterans. Baumgartner Issues Statement on Final Passage of FY27 NDAA - Michael Baumgartner Skip to Main Baumgartner Issues Statement on Final Passage of FY27 NDAA July 22, 2026 | Press Releases WASHINGTON, D.C. — Today, Congressman Michael Baumgartner (WA-05) issued the following statement upon the passage of the final Fiscal Year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA).  “ I am proud to support the passage of the NDAA and stand with the brave men and women who wear our nation’s uniform, ” said Congressman Baumgartner. “ This legislation strengthens support for our Fairchild servicemembers and their families by increasing their pay and enhancing housing, education, and access to childcare, while ensuring our military has the tools and capabilities needed to deter our adversaries and defend the American way of life. ” “ I am also pleased the House approved my amendment to authorize a $5 million investment in Reactive Alloy Structure (RAS) manufacturing, a critical new munitions technology developed at Washington State University and manufactured in Spokane, ” Baumgartner continued. “In defense, every ounce of weight requires expensive fuel to fly. This technology will make our defense systems lighter, stronger, and more efficient, ” he said. RAS Background:   Reactive Alloy Structure (RAS) was invented by Washington State University researchers under contract to DARPA (Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency) and is working with Applied Research Associates (ARA) to manufacture the munitions; ARA recently opened an industrial high-bay facility in Spokane, Washington to support RAS manufacturing; In testing, RAS has demonstrated all the key qualities of hardened steel while also generating significant blast effects; It’s effectiveness at destroying electronic systems is an astonishing 250% increase over an equivalent, non-RAS charge; and This effectiveness against electronics is especially important as US forces deal with an increasing quantity of enemy drones in combat operations.
